args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1 to production, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. I rolled all three regions back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Afterward the service passed health checks in every region, and the error rate fell to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, and it paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery numbers. It also notes that v2.3.1's release candidate was already unhealthy in staging. It lists finding the root cause in v2.3.1 as the follow-up before anyone redeploys it.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
